parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables this {{object}}. This parameter is based on ''ifAdminStatus'' from {{bibref|RFC2863}}.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The current operational state of this {{object}} (see {{bibref|TR-181i2|Section 4.2.2}}). {{enum}} When {{param|Enable}} is {{false}} then {{param}} SHOULD normally be {{enum|Disabled}} or {{enum|Error}} if there is a fault condition on the interface). When {{param|Enable}} is changed to {{true}} then {{param}} SHOULD change to {{enum|Enabled}} if and only if the interface is able to transmit and receive PDUs; it SHOULD change to {{enum|Unknown}} if the state of the interface can not be determined for some reason.

parameters.name: LastChangeDate
parameters.description: The date and time at which this {{object}} entered into its current operational state.

parameters.name: Host
parameters.description: The hostname or IP Address of the STOMP Server.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port number of the STOMP Server.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: The username part of the credentials to be used when authenticating this {{object}} during connection establishment with the STOMP Server.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password part of the credentials to be used when authenticating this {{object}} during connection establishment with the STOMP Server.

parameters.name: VirtualHost
parameters.description: The Virtual Host to use when establishing the connection. Some STOMP Server implementations utilize virtual hosts to place a context around credentials, permissions, and internal resources.

parameters.name: EnableHeartbeats
parameters.description: Enable or disable the STOMP Heart-beating mechanism as described in STOMP (for this {{object}}). When the STOMP Heart-beat mechanism is enabled, {{param|OutgoingHeartbeat}} and {{param|IncomingHeartbeat}} determine how the heart-beat header within the CONNECT frame is formatted. When the STOMP Heart-beat mechanism is disabled, {{param|OutgoingHeartbeat}} and {{param|IncomingHeartbeat}} are ignored and the CONNECT frame MUST NOT contain a heart-beat header element. Any changes to this parameter will not take effect until the next connection.

parameters.name: OutgoingHeartbeat
parameters.description: Represents the Outgoing heart-beat timing (in {{units}}) of the STOMP Heart-beating mechanism as described in STOMP (for this {{object}}). The Outgoing heart-beat represents what the sender of the frame can do. A value of 0 means that it cannot send heart-beats. Any changes to this parameter will not take effect until the next connection.

parameters.name: IncomingHeartbeat
parameters.description: Represents the Incoming heart-beat timing (in {{units}}) of the STOMP Heart-beating mechanism as described in STOMP (for this {{object}}). The Incoming heart-beat represents what the sender of the frame would like to get. A value of 0 means that it does not want to receive heart-beats. Any changes to this parameter will not take effect until the next connection.

parameters.name: ServerRetryInitialInterval
parameters.description: The maximum first reconnection wait interval, in {{units}}, as specified in {{bibref|TR-369}}. The Device MUST use a random value between ''0'' and {{param}} as the first reconnection wait interval.

parameters.name: ServerRetryIntervalMultiplier
parameters.description: The reconnection interval multiplier as specified in {{bibref|TR-369}}. This value is expressed in units of 0.001. Hence the values of the multiplier range between 1.000 and 65.535. For the ''n''th reconnection wait interval, the Device MUST use a random value, in ''seconds'', between ''0'' and {{param|ServerRetryInitialInterval}} * ({{param}} / 1000) ** (''n'' - ''1''). The server retry mechanism reaches its upper limit at 10 reconnection attempts. Meaning, that if the number of reconnection attempts exceeds 10, then the Device MUST use a random value, in seconds, between 0 and ServerRetryInitialInterval * (ServerRetryIntervalMultiplier / 1000) ** (10 - 1).

parameters.name: ServerRetryMaxInterval
parameters.description: The maximum reconnection wait interval, in {{units}}. If the ''n''th reconnection wait interval calculated from {{param|ServerRetryInitialInterval}} and {{param|ServerRetryIntervalMultiplier}} exceeds the value of this parameter, then the Agent MUST use the value of this parameter as the next reconnection wait interval.

parameters.name: IsEncrypted
parameters.description: This parameter represents whether or not communications that utilize this {{object}} object instance are encrypted. {{deprecated|2.14|because the {{param|EnableEncryption}} parameter will dictate whether all connections for this STOMP instance are or are not encrypted}} {{obsoleted|2.16}} {{deleted|2.17}}

parameters.name: EnableEncryption
parameters.description: When {{true}}, encryption MUST be used for this STOMP Connection {{object}}.

object.description: The {{object}} represents a STOMP connection between the Agent and a STOMP server.
